notes: Every entry is written by hand for this corpus and reviewed as data; no third-party payload file is vendored.

argv is a JSON array. An element that is a JSON string is the UTF-8 text of that argument. An element that is an object of the form {"base64": "..."} is the argument's raw bytes in standard base64 with padding, which is how an argument that is not valid UTF-8, or that should be read as bytes, is written. No other element form is accepted.
reason is the gate's own reason value, compared exactly. limits are the limits the corpus is evaluated under.
